name: @iflow-mcp/shawnrushefsky-comfyui-mcp

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get the current status of ComfyUI connection and installation

tools.name: get_install_guide
tools.description: Get installation instructions for ComfyUI (recommends desktop app for most users)

tools.name: get_model_guide
tools.description: Get guidance on downloading and installing models for ComfyUI

modelType.description: Type of model to get guidance for

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: List official ComfyUI example workflows from the documentation. RECOMMENDED: Always check examples first before building custom workflows - they provide tested, working templates for common use cases like txt2img, img2img, ControlNet, LoRA, regional prompting, and more.

category.description: Filter by category (basics, sdxl, flux, video, audio, controlnet, etc.)

tools.name: get_example_workflow
tools.description: Fetch an example workflow (extracts embedded JSON from documentation images). Returns ready-to-use workflow JSON that can be passed directly to run_workflow. Use this as a starting point and modify prompts, models, or parameters as needed.

name.description: Name of the example workflow to fetch

tools.name: extract_workflow
tools.description: Extract the workflow JSON from a ComfyUI-generated PNG image. Works with local file paths or URLs. Returns the workflow in API format that can be passed directly to run_workflow.

source.description: Path to a local PNG file or URL of a PNG image with embedded ComfyUI workflow

tools.name: recommend_workflow
tools.description: IMPORTANT: Call this BEFORE generating images to get the correct workflow and settings for a model. Given a model filename, returns the recommended workflow, optimal settings (steps, CFG, resolution), and prompting guide. Essential for matching checkpoint vs UNET models to the right workflow.

availableCheckpoints.description: List of available checkpoint files (from list_models)

availableUnets.description: List of available UNET files (from list_models)

tools.name: get_prompting_guide
tools.description: Get prompting best practices for AI image generation models (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3, Flux)

modelType.description: Model type to get prompting guide for (sd15, sdxl, sd3, flux, or all)

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get the detected capabilities of the connected ComfyUI instance

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a custom ComfyUI workflow (API format JSON). Returns immediately with a task ID (async by default). Use get_task to check progress, get_task_result to retrieve results when complete. Set sync:true to wait for completion (blocking). IMPORTANT: Use the 'name' parameter with descriptive names like 'sunset_portrait_v2' or 'logo_design_red' to make generations easy to find later. BEST PRACTICE: Always start from example workflows (list_examples/get_example_workflow) or templates (search_templates/get_template) rather than building workflows from scratch.

outputMode.description: Images are always saved to disk with absolute paths returned. This controls base64 inclusion: 'file' = path only, 'base64' = path + inline data, 'auto' = path + inline if small

imageFormat.description: Output image format (jpeg is smallest, png is lossless, webp is modern)

imageQuality.description: Image quality for JPEG/WebP (1-100, higher = better quality but larger)

sync.description: If true, wait for workflow to complete and return results directly (blocking). Default is async (non-blocking).

name.description: Descriptive name for this generation (e.g., 'beach_sunset_v2', 'logo_blue_variant'). Use clear, searchable names to find it later with get_generation_by_name.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Retrieve a generated image as base64. Use this to fetch images from ComfyUI's output directory.

filename.description: The filename of the image to retrieve (e.g., 'ComfyUI_00001_.png')

imageFormat.description: Output image format (jpeg is smallest, png is lossless, webp is modern)

imageQuality.description: Image quality for JPEG/WebP (1-100, higher = better quality but larger)

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available models (checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs, etc.) in ComfyUI

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List available ComfyUI nodes, optionally filtered by category or search term

search.description: Search term to filter node names

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ComfyUI node, including its inputs (with types, defaults, and valid options) and outputs. Essential for understanding how to wire nodes together in workflows.

tools.name: find_nodes_by_type
tools.description: Find ComfyUI nodes by their input or output types. Use this to discover which nodes can produce a specific type (e.g., MODEL, LATENT, IMAGE) or which nodes can consume a type. Essential for workflow composition.

inputType.description: Find nodes that accept this input type (e.g., 'MODEL', 'LATENT', 'IMAGE', 'CONDITIONING')

outputType.description: Find nodes that produce this output type (e.g., 'MODEL', 'LATENT', 'IMAGE', 'CONDITIONING')

tools.name: build_node
tools.description: Generate valid node JSON with proper inputs/outputs that can be assembled into a workflow. Provide inputs to override defaults, or leave empty to get a node with default values and placeholders for connections.

nodeId.description: The node ID for this node in the workflow (e.g., '1', '5')

inputs.description: Input values to set. For connections, use [nodeId, slotIndex] format. Omitted inputs use defaults.

tools.name: validate_workflow
tools.description: Validate a workflow before running it. Checks that all node types exist, connections are valid, required inputs are provided, and types match. Returns errors and warnings.

workflow.description: The ComfyUI workflow JSON (API format) to validate

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search for workflow templates by model type, task type, category, or text. Returns templates from built-in workflows, ComfyUI examples, and custom saved templates. Use get_template to generate workflow JSON from a template.

query.description: Free text search across workflow names and descriptions

includeExamples.description: Include example workflows from ComfyUI docs

includeCustom.description: Include custom saved templates from the database

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Generate workflow JSON from a template with provided parameters. Returns a complete workflow that can be passed to run_workflow. Works with built-in and custom saved templates.

parameters.description: Parameters for the template (e.g., { prompt: 'a cat', width: 1024 })

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a workflow as a reusable template. Use descriptive names that indicate the purpose (e.g., 'portrait_lighting_studio', 'product_photo_white_bg'). Templates are stored persistently and can be searched and retrieved later.

description.description: Description of what this template does

modelType.description: Model architecture this template is designed for

taskType.description: Type of task this template performs

defaultSettings.description: Default settings (steps, cfg, width, height, etc.)

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a custom saved template. Built-in templates cannot be deleted.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Get the download URL for a model by name. Searches common model names and returns download URLs, destinations, and wget commands. Useful for helping users download missing models.

modelName.description: The model name or partial name to search for (e.g., 'flux1-schnell', 'sdxl', 't5xxl')

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: Get the current ComfyUI queue status

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued job by prompt ID. NOTE: This only works for jobs that are queued (pending), NOT for jobs that are already running. To stop a running job, use the 'interrupt' tool instead.

promptId.description: Specific prompt ID to cancel. If not provided, cancels all jobs.

tools.name: interrupt
tools.description: Interrupt the currently running job. Use this to stop a job that is actively generating. For queued jobs that haven't started yet, use 'cancel_job' instead.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Get generation history

promptId.description: Specific prompt ID to get history for

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the current status of an async generation task. Returns progress info including current step, total steps, average step time, estimated remaining time, and a suggested poll interval based on generation speed.

taskId.description: The task ID to get status for

tools.name: get_task_result
tools.description: Get the result of a completed generation task (images)

taskId.description: The task ID to get results for

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List all generation tasks, optionally filtered by status

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel an async generation task. For queued tasks, this cancels the ComfyUI job. For tasks that are already running, this only removes the task from tracking - use 'interrupt' to actually stop the running generation.

tools.name: get_generation_by_name
tools.description: Retrieve a generation by its user-assigned name. Returns the same format as get_task_result.

name.description: The name assigned to the generation

tools.name: name_generation
tools.description: Assign a descriptive name to an existing generation for easy retrieval. Use clear, searchable names that describe the content (e.g., 'landscape_sunset_warm', 'logo_draft_2', 'character_portrait_final').

name.description: The name to assign - use descriptive names like 'hero_banner_blue' or 'product_shot_v3' that clearly identify the content

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Save a note about something learned during image generation. Useful for remembering model behaviors, prompting techniques, workflow patterns, etc.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: Retrieve saved notes, optionally filtered by topic.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes using full-text search.

query.description: Search query (searches topic, content, and tags)

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the note to delete

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all unique topics that have notes.

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description: Get user preferences extracted from analyzing their ComfyUI output history. Returns commonly used workflows (as reusable templates), frequently used models, and preferred settings.

tools.name: render_svg
tools.description: Render SVG content to PNG and save to ComfyUI's input folder. Returns filename for use in LoadImage nodes. Useful for creating precise base images for img2img workflows.

svg.description: SVG content to render (full SVG markup including <svg> tags)

background.description: Background color (default: transparent). Use hex like '#ffffff' or 'transparent'

name.description: Font name (must be downloaded first with download_font)

family.description: CSS font-family name to use in the SVG (defaults to font name)

fonts.description: Fonts to embed in the SVG for rendering

tools.name: download_font
tools.description: Download a font from Google Fonts or a direct URL for use in SVG rendering. Fonts are cached locally and can be embedded in SVGs via render_svg. Popular fantasy/map fonts: Cinzel, Pirata One, MedievalSharp, UnifrakturMaguntia, Almendra.

url.description: Direct URL to a .ttf, .otf, or .woff2 font file

name.description: Name to save the font as (without extension)

source.description: Font source - either Google Fonts or a direct URL

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List all downloaded fonts available for use in SVG rendering.
